## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

Monitor Financial dispersion (JPM ABOVE TREND vs BLK/CME BELOW TREND) for rotation signals.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, favoring Value/Cyclical style given Materials and Industrials leadership versus broad Tech softness. DD, AMAT, CAT and ABBV are showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND) while AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL are showing uniform weakness (BELOW TREND). Key risk is concentrated Big Tech downside and sentiment/price divergences on XOM and other news-driven names — monitor for confirmation before repositioning.
